candidate_policy: Every primary curriculum candidate, selected or not, including zero-update and scope-ineligible branches. No identity deduplication and no filtering on follow-on outcomes.
direct_source_checkpoints: Retained as source metadata only; this block does not launch another 24 direct references
optimizer_choice: Explicit continuation intervention: new AdamW state at each source candidate endpoint, matching the manuscript branch convention. Original candidate optimizer moments are not inherited.
paired_random_streams: verge_followon_v1_paired_{source_arm}_r{source_round:02d}; shared by the three candidates in one source cohort, new relative to primary streams
initial_endpoint: Reuse the saved source-candidate fixed-checkpoint endpoint as source metadata; no additional initial audit or model draws
event_clock: Cumulative charged follow-on loss tokens at the end of the first verified training group containing a full success; selection/completion events are at budget B. Record generated-token counts and event role separately. This is a grouped observation clock, not exact wall time or the optimizer step at which capability arose.
censoring: A fully executed event-free continuation is right-censored at B; no event means no observed success within this budget, not zero eventual success probability. Technical failures must recover or remain explicitly incomplete, not count as completed failures.
pre_success_analysis: Use source cohorts with no recorded full event on that arm through the source round, including initial, training, endpoint and completion. Keep every candidate trained and all other cohorts as separately labelled post-ignition observations; never filter on follow-on outcomes.
ranking_strata: Compare three candidates within each common source cohort, retaining arm, round, source Solver and condition rung. Do not pool disparate starts into a causal ranking.
condition_score: Saved endpoint condition gain with the existing zero-update identity correction; keep raw endpoint difference separately
uncertainty_score: Previously logged curriculum-training stage uncertainty, without new stage probes
tie_rule: Uniform exact enumeration of descending score-compatible orders for each three-candidate cohort
random_reference: Exact uniform enumeration of all six orders of the same three executed candidates; not six extra training runs
rank_statistics: Observed event fraction and any-event indicator at top 1/2/3, averaged over allowed orders. Conservative comparable-pair concordance requires a strictly earlier observed event; equal score half credit, equal event/censor times excluded, no comparable pairs yields null. Descriptive within-cohort Kaplan-Meier only.
inference_limit: One training seed and adaptive same-arm rounds are dependent. Report cohort-level results and descriptive aggregate numerators/denominators, not iid-branch or cross-seed confidence intervals. Final-checkpoint rates stay separate from trajectory event statistics.
